snippet.title: Construction Store Simulator - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🏗️🔨 CONSTRUCTION STORE SIMULATOR LAUNCHES NOVEMBER 3!

👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3891470/Construction_Store_Simulator

Stock shelves, serve customers, drive forklifts, and build your own construction supply empire! 💪

📅 November 3, 2026 | 💲 $9.99

🎉 Help us reach a special wishlist milestone and unlock a 25% launch discount!

Add the game to your Steam Wishlist and spread the word to make it happen!
